edit.text: Dormammu tries to reach Earth through Baron Mordo's cult, and Spider-Man helps Doctor Strange keep him in the Dark Dimension.
edit.whoA: A demon lord Peter helps keep off Earth.
edit.whoB: Helps keep Dormammu out of Earth.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
add.text: Dormammu tries again to reach Earth through Venom and Carnage, and Spider-Man reverses the portal and sends him back.
add.whoA: A demon lord Peter sends back.
add.whoB: Seals Dormammu away.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
edit.text: After Xavier turns Spider-Man away, Beast tells him about Herbert Landon's cure for mutation. Landon's men then capture Beast.
edit.whoB: Goes to Landon on Beast's word.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#18
add.text: Spider-Man searches for the captured Beast with Wolverine and helps rescue him from Landon.
add.whoA: Rescued by Peter from Landon.
add.whoB: Rescues Beast from Landon.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#17
edit.text: Dr. Herbert Landon offers mutants a cure while secretly planning to destroy them, and his men capture Beast.
edit.whoA: A scientist with a false cure for mutants.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#44
add.text: Landon becomes the Kingpin's chief scientist. He turns Alistair into a cyborg and Felicia into the Black Cat.
add.whoA: The Kingpin's mad scientist.
add.whoB: A hero who foils Landon's work.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#22
edit.text: Blade comes to New York to destroy Morbius, while Spider-Man wants to cure him. They clash over it but team up to stop Morbius.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
add.text: Spider-Man and Blade fight the vampire queen Miriam together.
add.whoA: A vampire hunter Peter works with.
add.whoB: A hero who wants to save Morbius, not destroy him like Blade.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#22
edit.text: Whistler, Blade's mentor, comes to New York with Blade to hunt Morbius, and tells Spider-Man how he found Blade.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#48
add.text: Whistler joins the hunt for the vampire queen Miriam that Spider-Man helps stop.
add.whoA: Blade's mentor and Peter's ally.
add.whoB: A hero working with Blade, whom Whistler joins.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#58
edit.text: Freed from a vortex decades after World War II, Captain America fights the Red Skull beside Spider-Man, then is lost in the vortex again.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
add.text: Spider-Man brings Captain America to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
add.whoA: A hero Peter fights beside.
add.whoB: A modern hero Captain America fights beside.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#13
edit.text: The Chameleon, a master of disguise, tries to kill two diplomats until Spider-Man and S.H.I.E.L.D. catch him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
add.text: The Chameleon returns with the Insidious Six, helps frame Peter, and finally betrays the Kingpin for his stepfather, the Red Skull.
add.whoA: A spy who can wear any face.
add.whoB: Keeps catching the Chameleon.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
edit.text: Dr. Curt Connors is Peter's science teacher at ESU. An experiment turns him into the Lizard, and Spider-Man has to bring him back.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#51
add.text: Connors helps Spider-Man with the alien symbiote and his mutation, but stress and his own experiments keep turning him back into the Lizard.
add.whoA: Peter's science teacher, who sometimes becomes the Lizard.
add.whoB: Connors's student. As Spider-Man, brings him back from the Lizard.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#33
edit.text: When Peter is framed for selling government secrets, lawyer Matt Murdock defends him, and as Daredevil he rescues Peter from a fake Spider-Man.
edit.whoB: Matt's client, whom Daredevil rescues.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#34
add.text: As Daredevil, Matt helps Spider-Man clear Peter's name and reveals that Wilson Fisk is the Kingpin.
add.whoA: Peter's lawyer, secretly Daredevil.
add.whoB: Matt's client, and as Spider-Man, his partner.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#4
edit.text: Doctor Octopus kidnaps Felicia to make her mother pay him, and Peter recognizes him as Otto Octavius, his old science teacher.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#30
add.text: Doctor Octopus fights Spider-Man again and again, leading the Insidious Six and even wiping his memory to use him as a partner in crime.
add.whoA: Peter's old teacher, now a villain.
add.whoB: The hero who keeps stopping Doctor Octopus.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
edit.text: Eddie Brock is a rival reporter who competes with Peter for a picture of the Lizard.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#10
add.text: Jameson fires Eddie twice over stories about Spider-Man, and Eddie blames the hero for ruining his life.
add.whoA: A rival reporter to Peter.
add.whoB: A rival photographer of Eddie's at the Bugle.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#2
edit.text: Felicia Hardy is Peter's well-off classmate at ESU, and he starts dating her.
edit.whoA: A wealthy classmate Peter dates.
edit.whoB: Felicia's classmate, who dates her.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#44
edit.text: Once the Kingpin's serum makes her the Black Cat, Felicia turns on him, and Spider-Man helps her free her father. They become partners in the field.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#32
add.text: After Spider-Man saves her mother, Felicia falls for him without knowing he is Peter and kisses him, but he tells her he cannot have a girlfriend.
add.whoA: A classmate Peter dates, who falls for Spider-Man.
add.whoB: Felicia's classmate. Secretly Spider-Man, the hero she falls for.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#63
add.text: Felicia and Spider-Man fight vampires, Hydro-Man and the villains of the Beyonder's world side by side, and they share a kiss there.
add.whoA: Peter's partner in the field, with feelings for him.
add.whoB: Felicia's partner in the field, and the man she loves.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#12
edit.text: Harry Osborn, Norman's son, is Peter's friend. Spider-Man brings him home when the Hobgoblin kidnaps him.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#49
edit.text: Driven by visions of his lost father, Harry becomes the new Green Goblin and fights Spider-Man, until he collapses and Spider-Man takes him to get help.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#35
add.text: Harry is for a while Peter's roommate, and he dates and gets engaged to Mary Jane while she is apart from Peter.
add.whoA: Peter's friend and roommate, Norman Osborn's son.
add.whoB: Harry's friend and roommate.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#53
add.text: Harry is sent to Ravencroft, then returns as the Goblin to attack Peter's wedding to Mary Jane, until Liz Allan talks him down.
add.whoA: Peter's friend, now the Green Goblin, out to kill him.
add.whoB: The hero Harry blames for his own father's loss.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#12
edit.text: Norman Osborn is Harry's father. When the Hobgoblin kidnaps Harry to strike at Norman, Spider-Man steps in.
edit.whoA: Norman's son.
edit.whoB: Harry's father, the head of Oscorp.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#49
add.text: When Norman vanishes into a portal, Harry believes he is dead, and the Green Goblin calls out to him from limbo, pushing him to become the new Green Goblin.
add.whoA: Norman's son. Norman pushes him into becoming the Goblin.
add.whoB: Harry's father, whose footsteps Harry follows as the Goblin.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#11
edit.text: The Hobgoblin is a mercenary on a glider who plays Norman Osborn and the Kingpin against each other.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#40
add.text: The Hobgoblin kidnaps Harry, and he is finally exposed as Jason Macendale, Felicia's fiance, and arrested.
add.whoA: A goblin for hire.
add.whoB: Keeps foiling the Hobgoblin.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#10
edit.text: Quentin Beck works on the Chameleon's scheme to frame Spider-Man.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#25
add.text: As Mysterio, Beck attacks Spider-Man and is unmasked. Later he strikes again, but each Mysterio Spider-Man catches turns out to be a robot decoy.
add.whoA: The hero Mysterio haunts with tricks and decoys.
add.whoB: A master of illusions Peter never quite catches.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Otto Octavius is a timid Oscorp scientist who works for Norman.
edit.whoA: Norman's timid scientist.
edit.whoB: Otto's boss at Oscorp.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#6
add.text: Norman bullies Otto, and on his orders Otto runs the experiments that create the Sandman and the Rhino.
add.whoA: Norman's timid scientist. Norman bullies him.
add.whoB: Otto's abusive boss.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Eddie and Peter grew up like brothers, and Eddie is now the lab assistant in Connors's lab.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#12
edit.text: When Peter casts off the symbiote, it bonds to the vengeful Eddie, who becomes Venom.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#11
add.text: Eddie, whose parents died in the same plane crash as Peter's, starts to resent Peter for never being there.
add.whoA: A big brother to Peter since childhood.
add.whoB: The little brother Eddie grew up with.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#20
add.text: Venom goes after everyone Peter loves until Spider-Man strips the symbiote away, and Eddie is sent to Ravencroft.
add.whoA: Peter's old friend, turned enemy as Venom.
add.whoB: The brother Eddie wants to destroy.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Gwen is Peter's best friend and fellow intern in Dr. Connors's lab, and she has quietly loved him for years.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#14
add.text: After Venom targets her, Gwen kisses Peter, and he realizes he feels the same.
add.whoA: Peter's best friend, who quietly loves him.
add.whoB: Gwen's best friend, whom she has loved for years.

edit.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Harry is Peter's best friend, neglected by his father Norman.

add.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#9
add.text: Harry secretly takes an Oscorp formula, and Spider-Man finds him taking off the Green Goblin's mask. Harry then leaves for Europe to recover.
add.whoA: Peter's best friend, Norman Osborn's neglected son.
add.whoB: Harry's best friend.

edit.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#1
edit.text: Spider-Man fails to stop Carnage and Venom from hijacking John Jameson's ship to Counter-Earth.

add.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#3
add.text: Spider-Man fights Carnage and Venom on Counter-Earth, where they turn out to be behind the kidnapping of Naoko Yamada-Jones.
add.whoA: Peter's symbiote enemy.
add.whoB: Carnage's enemy.

edit.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#1
edit.text: Spider-Man fails to stop Venom and Carnage from hijacking John Jameson's ship to Counter-Earth, and follows them there.
edit.whoA: Peter's old enemy, who flees to Counter-Earth.
edit.whoB: Eddie's enemy, who follows him to Counter-Earth.

add.title: Spider-Man Unlimited#11
add.text: When the Bestials separate Eddie from his symbiote, Spider-Man reluctantly wears it to recover it and returns it before Eddie dies.
add.whoA: Peter's old enemy. Peter still saves him.
add.whoB: Eddie's enemy, who saves his life.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#1
edit.text: Betty Brant is Jameson's secretary at the Daily Bugle. She is captured in Doctor Octopus's hidden lab, and Spider-Man frees them both.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#22
add.text: Spider-Man also saves Betty from Parafino and a shadow tiger, and she helps him escape Henry Smythe's robot. A flashback shows Peter first meeting her when he joins the Daily Bugle.
add.whoA: Jameson's secretary, and Peter's friend at the Bugle.
add.whoB: Betty's friend at the Bugle, and as Spider-Man, her rescuer.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#1
edit.text: Doctor Octopus plans to blow up part of New York from a hidden lab and traps Spider-Man and Betty there, until Spider-Man stops him.
edit.whoB: Foils Doctor Octopus's bomb plot.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#17
add.text: Spider-Man stops Doctor Octopus again when he steals Dr. Smartyr's Nullifier.
add.whoA: Peter's nemesis.
add.whoB: Foils Doctor Octopus twice.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#2
edit.text: Electro frames Spider-Man for his robberies, until Spider-Man catches him at an abandoned amusement park.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#19
add.text: Electro escapes again and again, and Spider-Man catches him each time.
add.whoA: Frames Peter for robberies.
add.whoB: The hero Electro frames.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#6
edit.text: The Green Goblin dabbles in witchcraft to summon demons, using Jameson as his medium. Spider-Man tracks him to a graveyard and stops him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#19
add.text: After Dr. Noah Boddy frees him from prison, Spider-Man stops the Green Goblin again.
add.whoA: A villain who dabbles in witchcraft, whom Peter stops.
add.whoB: Foils the Green Goblin's spells.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#12
edit.text: The invisible Dr. Noah Boddy targets Jameson until Spider-Man webs him up.
edit.whoA: An invisible villain Peter webs up.
edit.whoB: Webs up Boddy.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#19
add.text: Boddy frees three villains to destroy Spider-Man, and all four end up in jail.
add.whoA: An invisible villain Peter jails twice.
add.whoB: Jails Boddy twice.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#10
edit.text: A master of disguise poses as a visiting Prime Minister to raise millions from Jameson, until Spider-Man exposes him as Charles Cameo.
edit.whoA: A master of disguise Peter unmasks.
edit.whoB: Exposes Cameo.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#19
add.text: Cameo poses as Peter and then as Spider-Man to steal art treasures, and Spider-Man catches him again.
add.whoA: A master of disguise who impersonates Peter.
add.whoB: The hero Cameo impersonates.

edit.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#1
edit.text: Pearl babysat Peter until he was twelve, and she is his childhood crush. They reunite at Bales High, where she is dating Lonnie.

add.title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man#7
add.text: Spider-Man saves Pearl when the Scorpion attacks the 110th Street gang's hideout.
add.whoA: The boy Pearl used to babysit.
add.whoB: Peter's old babysitter, whom he saves as Spider-Man.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#1
edit.text: J. Jonah Jameson buys Peter's photos for the Daily Bugle while waging a crusade against Spider-Man.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#22
add.text: Spider-Man still rescues Jameson again and again, once making him say please first. A flashback shows Jameson hiring Peter as a Bugle photographer.
add.whoA: Peter's boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.
add.whoB: Jameson's photographer. Secretly Spider-Man, Jameson's favorite target.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#8
edit.text: May is Peter's aunt. She fusses over him and keeps him in bed when he catches a cold.
edit.whoA: Peter's aunt, who fusses over him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#22
add.text: After Uncle Ben's murder May falls ill, so Peter takes a job at the Daily Bugle to pay for her medicine, and he later finds the Kingpin's counterfeit drug ring made it.
add.whoA: Peter's aunt, whose medicine he works to pay for.
add.whoB: May's nephew, whom she fusses over.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#22
edit.text: The Kingpin runs the counterfeit drug ring that made Aunt May's medicine and kidnaps Jameson to stop an expose, until Spider-Man rescues Jameson and puts the ring out of business.
edit.whoB: Shuts down the Kingpin's drug ring.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#42
add.text: The Kingpin later hides a brainwashing scheme in a Times Square nightclub, and Spider-Man shuts it down.
add.whoA: The crime boss whose fake drugs Peter's Aunt May takes.
add.whoB: Shuts down the Kingpin's rackets.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#7
edit.text: Parafino traps Spider-Man and Betty above hot wax to make him an exhibit, until Spider-Man beats him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#11
add.text: Parafino returns with wax robots, and Spider-Man beats him again.
add.whoA: A wax artist who wants Peter as an exhibit.
add.whoB: The exhibit Parafino wants.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#15
edit.text: Two thieves pose as a single Human Fly to steal jewelry, until Spider-Man tracks them to an abandoned amusement park and catches them both.
edit.whoA: Two thieves Peter catches.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#20
add.text: Paroled twins Stan and Lee Patterson frame Spider-Man for a vault robbery, and he catches them again.
add.whoA: Twin thieves Peter catches.
add.whoB: Catches the Human Flies.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#3
edit.text: Mysterio frames Spider-Man for a robbery and offers to trap him for Jameson, until Spider-Man records his confession.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#48
add.text: Mysterio returns with tricks and illusions, and Spider-Man beats him each time.
add.whoA: A master of illusions who frames Peter.
add.whoB: The hero Mysterio frames and fools.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#8
edit.text: The Rhino steals parts of a secret weapon, and Spider-Man catches him at his zoo hideout.
edit.whoB: Catches the Rhino at his zoo hideout.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#48
add.text: The Rhino raids gold shipments to build statues of himself, and Spider-Man catches him again each time.
add.whoA: A horned brute.
add.whoB: Keeps catching the Rhino.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#5
edit.text: The Scorpion is made to catch Spider-Man for Jameson, then turns on Jameson. Spider-Man webs him up, and catches him again after he breaks out of prison.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#20
add.text: The Scorpion escapes prison again and grows into a giant, and Spider-Man shrinks him with the antidote and webs him up.
add.whoA: A mutated man Peter keeps jailing.
add.whoB: The hero the Scorpion was made to catch.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#4
edit.text: The Vulture turns an army of vultures on New York for a ransom, until Spider-Man turns the birds against him.
edit.whoB: The hero who beats the Vulture.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#40
add.text: The Vulture returns to steal a military rocket and a missile meant to stop him, and Spider-Man beats him each time.
add.whoA: A winged thief Peter beats.
add.whoB: The hero who keeps catching the Vulture.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#2
edit.text: Testing a swamp fever serum on himself, Dr. Connors becomes the Lizard, and Spider-Man cures him at an old Spanish fort.
edit.whoA: A doctor Peter cures.
edit.whoB: Cures the Lizard.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#40
add.text: Spider-Man rescues Dr. Connors when he is held prisoner at the same fort, and again from an alligator his work made intelligent.
add.whoA: A doctor Peter cures and rescues.
add.whoB: Cures and rescues the Lizard.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#23
edit.text: The Master Technician lifts Manhattan into the sky for ransom until Spider-Man beats him.
edit.whoA: Lifts Manhattan into the sky for ransom.
edit.whoB: Beats the Master Technician.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#50
add.text: As the Radiation Specialist he lifts Manhattan again and controls the city's minds, and Spider-Man beats him with Captain Stacy's help.
add.whoA: Lifts Manhattan into the sky twice.
add.whoB: Beats the Master Technician twice.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1967)#39
edit.text: Captain Ned Stacy rescues the injured Spider-Man from a mob, and Spider-Man saves him from a prison breakout.

add.title: Spider-Man (1967)#50
add.text: Stacy resists the Radiation Specialist's mind control, and Spider-Man rescues him from escaping convicts.
add.whoA: A police captain who trusts Peter.
add.whoB: A hero Captain Stacy stands up for.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#16
edit.text: Hydro-Man, Mary Jane's ex-boyfriend, stalks her to win her back, and Spider-Man fights him to save her.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#60
add.text: A clone of Hydro-Man made by Miles Warren kidnaps Mary Jane from their honeymoon.
add.whoA: Mary Jane's water-powered ex.
add.whoB: Stands between Morrie and Mary Jane.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#38
edit.text: Iron Man teams with Spider-Man and Venom to stop Carnage and Dormammu.
edit.whoA: Peter's ally against Carnage.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#61
add.text: Spider-Man summons Iron Man to the Beyonder's world to fight on his team.
add.whoA: Peter's ally against Carnage and on Battleworld.
add.whoB: A hero Iron Man teams with.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
edit.text: J. Jonah Jameson runs the Daily Bugle and buys Peter's photos, while hating Spider-Man.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#53
add.text: Jameson backs schemes to stop Spider-Man, yet has a soft spot for Peter, secretly hiring him a lawyer and giving him a van for his wedding.
add.whoA: Peter's boss at the Bugle, who hates Spider-Man.
add.whoB: Jameson's photographer, secretly the Spider-Man Jameson hates.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#21
edit.text: Cured, Kraven returns to help Spider-Man. He teams with the Punisher to subdue the Man-Spider.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#45
add.text: Kraven later works with Spider-Man and the Black Cat to save Mariah.
add.whoA: Now cured, comes back to help Peter.
add.whoB: Now a friend Kraven helps.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#7
edit.text: Dr. Mariah Crawford helps Spider-Man cure Kraven, the man she loves.
edit.whoA: A scientist who helps Peter cure Kraven.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#21
add.text: Later she gives Spider-Man a risky serum for his mutation and helps restore him from the Man-Spider.
add.whoA: A scientist who helps cure Peter.
add.whoB: Helps Mariah cure Kraven.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
edit.text: May is Peter's aunt, who raises him after his parents die and loves him like a son.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#54
add.text: May keeps trying to set Peter up with Mary Jane, and villains from the Scorpion to Morbius drag her into his fights. After his wedding, a visit from Ben's old friend Keene Marlow leaves her pressed to tell Peter the truth about his parents.
add.whoA: Peter's aunt, who raised him and worries over him.
add.whoB: May's nephew, whom she raised like a son.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#20
edit.text: Michael Morbius, Peter's ESU classmate, steals his mutated blood and is turned into a vampire. Spider-Man fights him while trying to cure him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#22
add.text: When Blade comes to destroy Morbius, Spider-Man keeps trying to cure him instead.
add.whoA: A classmate of Peter's turned vampire.
add.whoB: Fights to cure Morbius.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#5
edit.text: Quentin Beck uses special effects to frame Spider-Man for crimes, until Spider-Man and Terri Lee expose him.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#50
add.text: Mysterio returns with the Insidious Six and later with a trap for Mary Jane.
add.whoA: An effects wizard who frames Peter.
add.whoB: Exposes Mysterio.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#13
edit.text: Nick Fury of S.H.I.E.L.D. works to stop the Chameleon alongside Spider-Man.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#43
add.text: Spider-Man later goes to Fury for answers about Felicia's father.
add.whoA: The S.H.I.E.L.D. director, who works with Peter.
add.whoB: A hero Fury works with.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#2
edit.text: Norman Osborn, Harry's father and Oscorp's ruthless owner, hires Spencer Smythe to capture Spider-Man.
edit.whoA: Harry's father, Oscorp's ruthless owner.
edit.whoB: The hero Norman hires Smythe to catch.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#41
add.text: Norman becomes the Green Goblin, learns Peter's identity and kidnaps Mary Jane, and both vanish into a portal.
add.whoA: Harry's father, who becomes the Green Goblin.
add.whoB: The hero Norman hunts as the Green Goblin.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#21
edit.text: Kraven convinces the Punisher that the Man-Spider is an innocent victim, and the two subdue him so Mariah can cure him.
edit.whoA: Now helps bring Peter in for a cure.
edit.whoB: A hero the Punisher helps cure.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#49
add.text: Searching for Mary Jane for her aunt, the Punisher suspects Peter of being the Green Goblin, until Mary Jane reappears in front of them.
add.whoA: Helps cure Peter, then hunts for Mary Jane.
add.whoB: The hero the Punisher helps cure, and later suspects.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#57
edit.text: Freed from a vortex by his son and stepson, the Red Skull traps both Spider-Man and the Kingpin's side.
edit.whoB: A hero the Red Skull traps.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#62
add.text: The Red Skull turns his son into Electro, and on the Beyonder's world he rules an empire until Spider-Man's team defeats him.
add.whoA: A Nazi from World War II.
add.whoB: A hero who defeats the Red Skull twice.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#8
edit.text: The Rhino charges Spider-Man in his armored suit to steal the Promethium X for the Kingpin.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#15
add.text: The Rhino goes to prison rather than talk about the Kingpin, and returns with the Insidious Six.
add.whoA: A thug in an armored suit.
add.whoB: The hero the Rhino charges for the Kingpin.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#33
edit.text: Richard Fisk gives Peter a job at Fisktronics, then frames him for selling government secrets.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#34
add.text: Spider-Man and Daredevil clear Peter's name and send Richard to prison.
add.whoA: The Kingpin's son, who frames Peter.
add.whoB: The employee Richard frames.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#1
edit.text: Robbie Robertson is an editor at the Daily Bugle and a good friend to Peter who believes Spider-Man is a hero.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#55
add.text: Spider-Man saves Robbie from Kraven, helps him win back his son and clears his name, and Robbie takes Peter to Russia to look into his parents.
add.whoA: A Bugle editor and Peter's good friend.
add.whoB: A young friend of Robbie's at the Bugle.

edit.title: Spider-Man (1994)#6
edit.text: Jameson pays to have private eye Mac Gargan turned into the Scorpion to stop Spider-Man.

add.title: Spider-Man (1994)#53
add.text: The Scorpion fights Spider-Man many times, with the Insidious Six and on his own, and kidnaps Aunt May before Peter's wedding.
add.whoA: A private eye mutated to stop Peter.

add.text: When Magneto calls Xavier out, Xavier overwhelms him with memories of his past.
add.whoA: Xavier's old friend and greatest rival.
add.whoB: Magneto's old friend and greatest rival.

edit.title: X-Men '97#14
edit.text: In Egypt, Xavier distrusts young En Sabah Nur, who becomes Apocalypse, keeps Xavier from going home, and kills Magneto in front of him.
edit.whoB: Watches Apocalypse kill Erik.

add.title: X-Men '97#18
add.text: Xavier enters Gambit's mind and finds Apocalypse in control there, too strong for him to overcome.
add.whoA: Kills Erik before Xavier's eyes, and now hides in Gambit's mind.
add.whoB: Is overpowered by Apocalypse in Gambit's mind.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#31
edit.text: Lilandra seeks Xavier's help against her brother D'Ken, and they fall in love.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#76
add.text: When Gyrich strikes Xavier down, Lilandra brings a cure and takes him to the Shi'ar Empire to be healed.
add.whoA: The Shi'ar princess Xavier loves. Takes him away to heal.
add.whoB: The Earthman Lilandra loves. She takes him away to heal.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#5
add.text: Storm beats Callisto in a duel for leadership of the Morlocks to free Scott, then has Callisto rule in her place.
add.whoA: The Morlock leader Storm defeats.
add.whoB: Defeats Callisto for leadership of the Morlocks.

edit.title: X-Men '97#12
edit.text: Cooper's X-Factor hunts the young runaways that Cable's X-Force protects, and she brands X-Force fugitives.

add.title: X-Men '97#18
add.text: Cooper proposes an alliance between her X-Factor and Cable's X-Force.
add.whoA: Leads X-Force, which Cooper offers to ally with.
add.whoB: Offers X-Force an alliance with X-Factor.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
edit.text: Logan goes after Jubilee when the Sentinels take her, and becomes her protector. She looks up to him and tags along on his missions.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
edit.text: Morph is Logan's best friend, the only one who makes him laugh.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#16
add.text: Back from his apparent death but scarred by it, Morph hides away. Logan tracks him down and tries to bring him home, but accepts he needs time to heal.
add.whoA: Logan's best friend, still healing from the ordeal.
add.whoB: Morph's best friend. Tries to bring Morph home.

edit.text: Yuriko, Wolverine's former lover, blames him for her father's death and holds the Morlocks hostage to make him open an alien prison ship. After they hold off the creature inside together, she calls a draw.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#17
edit.text: Revived by rogue Russian generals, the Soviet super soldier Omega Red battles Wolverine, Colossus and Jubilee in Russia until Storm freezes him solid.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#47
add.text: Thawed to salvage a sunken Russian submarine, Omega Red insists that Wolverine go down with him, then turns on him.
add.whoA: Logan's Soviet foe. Turns on Logan on a sunken submarine.
add.whoB: Omega Red's foe, dragged down to the submarine.

edit.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#3
edit.text: Logan hates Sabretooth, an old enemy, and tries to get rid of him when Xavier takes him in to heal his rage.

add.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#61
add.text: Sabretooth stalks Wolverine again and again. At the ruins of the Weapon X lab, both learn many of their memories were implanted.
add.whoA: Logan's savage old enemy.
add.whoB: Sabretooth's old enemy.

edit.title: Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl#1
edit.text: Thor moves in with Darryl, an office worker in Australia, while the other Avengers fight over the Accords. Darryl helps him email Tony and Steve, and Thor makes him part of Team Thor.
edit.whoA: Darryl's flatmate. Makes Darryl part of Team Thor.

add.title: Team Thor, Team Thor: Part 2 & Team Darryl#2
add.text: Darryl gets stuck with most of the cleaning and puts up with Thor trying to pay rent in Asgardian money.
add.whoA: Darryl's flatmate. Leaves Darryl most of the cleaning.
add.whoB: Thor's Australian flatmate.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#4
add.text: In 1955, one of Sibyl's Chronicoms stays behind and offers to help Freddy, now a Hydra leader.
add.whoA: The Chronicom whose people offer Freddy their help.
add.whoB: Takes help from Sibyl's Chronicoms.

edit.title: What If...?#9
edit.text: Once Ultron falls, Killmonger betrays the team to take Ultron's armor and Stones for himself.

add.title: What If...?#18
add.text: As Strange's prisoner, Killmonger breaks free in the riot and, wearing Ultron's armor, tries to stop Peggy and Kahhori from shutting down the Forge.
add.whoA: Stands in Killmonger's way at the Forge.
add.whoB: A prisoner who blocks Peggy at the Forge.

edit.title: What If...?#3
edit.text: Loki stays on Earth and declares himself its ruler. Fury finds Steve Rogers in the ice and calls Captain Marvel to build a new team.
edit.whoA: Now Earth's ruler. Fury builds a team to stop him.

add.title: What If...?#9
add.text: With help from a Natasha from another world, Fury's new team fights Loki's rule.
add.whoA: Earth's conqueror, fought by Fury's new team.
add.whoB: Leads the team fighting Loki.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
add.text: In the temple, Sarge gives in to his true self as Pachakutiq. He stabs May and sends her through the portal as the sign Izel's people are waiting for.
add.whoA: Izel's old love Pachakutiq, awake at last and at her side.
add.whoB: The old love Pachakutiq wakes for and joins.

edit.text: Freddy Malick is Nathaniel's father, a HYDRA leader posing as a S.H.I.E.L.D. chief. In 1973, when Daisy and Sousa take Nathaniel hostage, Freddy calls off the Chronicoms and lets the agents go to save his son.
edit.whoA: Nathaniel's father. Lets S.H.I.E.L.D. go to save Nathaniel.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
add.text: When S.H.I.E.L.D. catches Garrett planting bombs at the Lighthouse, Nathaniel refuses to stop the blast and leaves him to die. Garrett turns and offers to help the agents.
add.whoA: A recruit Nathaniel leaves to die. Turns against Nathaniel.
add.whoB: The boss who leaves Garrett to die at the Lighthouse.

edit.text: Ego is Peter's father. He has Yondu deliver Peter to him and trains his powers, but Peter flees home to Earth, and Ego comes after him to start his Expansion.

add.title: What If...?#11
add.text: Peter turns on Ego and destroys his body while Peggy's forces hold Ego off. Afterward, he celebrates the win with her team at Hank's home.
add.whoA: Holds Ego off while Peter turns on him.
add.whoB: The boy who turns on Ego and saves the day.

add.title: What If...?#11
add.text: As T'Chaka hoped, Peter turns on Ego while T'Chaka fights to hold Ego off. Afterward, they celebrate the win together at Hank's home.
add.whoA: Holds Ego off while Peter turns on him.
add.whoB: The boy who turns on Ego, as T'Chaka hoped.

edit.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#2
edit.text: Sarge wears the face of Coulson, the man May loved. She hesitates when she faces him, and his crew pushes her out through a portal.
edit.whoA: The woman who loved Coulson.
edit.whoB: A man with Coulson's face.

add.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#12
add.text: After Sarge takes May prisoner and mocks her grief, she beats him and brings him in. She comes to hope there is good in him, but when he embraces his true self he stabs her and sends her through the portal.
add.whoA: The woman who loved Coulson. Sarge takes her prisoner, then stabs her.
add.whoB: A man with Coulson's face. Takes May prisoner, then stabs her.

edit.title: What If...?#9
edit.text: Killmonger betrays the Guardians to claim Ultron's armor and Stones. Strange traps him and Zola in a pocket dimension and stays behind to guard it.

add.title: What If...?#18
add.text: Strange keeps Killmonger among the prisoners in his Sanctum, captured to feed the Forge, until Peggy sets them free.
add.whoA: A prisoner Strange holds for the Forge.
add.whoB: Holds Killmonger prisoner for the Forge.

edit.text: Pepper is Tony's assistant, and she warns him against dealing with Klaue. After his death, she sets out to learn the truth.
edit.whoA: Tony's assistant. Warns Tony off Klaue.
edit.whoB: Pepper's boss. She looks into his death.

edit.text: Catherine and Tina run PRIDE's affairs side by side. Catherine resents Tina acting as its only leader, and is upset when Tina kills Molly's relative Graciela to silence her.

edit.title: Inhumans#1
edit.text: Maximus seizes Attilan in a coup and sends the strike team that shot Triton to kill his cousin Gorgon on Earth.

add.title: Inhumans#3
add.text: Maximus sends Auran's party, with the deadly Mordis, to kill Gorgon on Earth.
add.whoA: Gorgon's cousin. Sends killers after Gorgon.
add.whoB: Maximus's cousin. Maximus wants him dead.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#10
edit.text: Learning that Jonah has endangered Karolina, Leslie turns against him and plots with PRIDE to kill him.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
edit.text: Leslie secretly tends a frail man hidden in a chamber at the church office and tells him PRIDE has found someone to sacrifice to revive him.
edit.whoA: The frail man Leslie secretly tends.
edit.whoB: The devoted follower who tends Jonah in secret.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#5
add.text: Leslie is Jonah's devoted follower and secret lover, the mother of his daughter Karolina.
add.whoA: Leslie's secret lover, Karolina's father.
add.whoB: Jonah's devoted lover, mother of his child.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#7
edit.text: Jonah wins Frank over with healing gloves and a rising place in the church.
edit.whoA: Leslie's lover. Empowers Frank in the church.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#9
add.text: Frank tells Jonah what Karolina told him about the Runaways and lets them into the construction site so Jonah can find them.
add.whoA: Leslie's lover, whom Frank keeps working for.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband, who passes Jonah the Runaways' plans.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#15
add.text: Jonah demands that Frank find a teen to sacrifice or be cast out of the church. Frank refuses.
add.whoA: Leslie's lover, who demands a sacrifice Frank refuses.
add.whoB: Leslie's husband, who refuses Jonah's order.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#2
add.text: Darius, Geoffrey's old friend from Compton, storms Geoffrey's construction site to extort him. Geoffrey threatens Darius's grandmother to drive him off.
add.whoA: Geoffrey's old friend, now a gangster extorting him.
add.whoB: The old friend Darius extorts.

edit.title: Blade: The Series#1
edit.text: Chase is Marcus's second in command in the House of Chthon and carries out his schemes.

add.title: Blade: The Series#11
add.text: Charlotte asks Chase to keep an eye on Marcus. Chase tells him, and he agrees to be watched and sends Charlotte a piece of Blade's sword through her.
add.whoA: Marcus's second in command.
add.whoB: Chase's master in the House of Chthon.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#9
edit.text: Nico cannot forgive Alex for hiding what he knew about Amy, and she ends things between them before kissing Karolina. They stay friends and teammates.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#11
add.text: On the run, Nico questions where Alex gets his money and suspects he could be working for PRIDE.
add.whoA: Nico's ex, still a friend and teammate.
add.whoB: Alex's ex, still a friend and teammate.

edit.title: Runaways S1–S2#9
edit.text: Karolina kisses Nico while they search for Chase and Gert at the school dance, and Nico kisses her back.
edit.whoA: The friend who kisses Nico.
edit.whoB: The friend Karolina kisses.

edit.title: Runaways S3#6
edit.text: To save Alex, Nico agrees to train under Morgan le Fay and breaks up with Karolina, though she still loves her. Karolina worries about who Nico is becoming.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#12
add.text: On the run Nico and Karolina become girlfriends and plan the room they will share at the hostel.
add.whoA: Nico's girlfriend.
add.whoB: Karolina's girlfriend.

add.title: Runaways S3#9
add.text: Karolina stays at Nico's side and fights Morgan alongside her.
add.whoA: Nico's ex, still devoted to Nico.
add.whoB: Breaks up with Karolina to train under Morgan.

add.title: Runaways S3#6
add.text: Morgan le Fay offers to train Nico in magic so she can save Alex, and Nico accepts.
add.whoA: The sorceress who takes Nico on as her student.
add.whoB: The young witch Morgan agrees to train.

edit.title: Cloak & Dagger#1
edit.text: Liam is Tandy's boyfriend and her partner in robbing rich men.
edit.whoA: Tandy's boyfriend and partner in crime.
edit.whoB: Liam's girlfriend and partner in crime.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#2
add.text: Tandy tells Liam they are no longer a couple and leaves him to be arrested, ignoring his call for help.
add.whoA: Tandy's ex, whom she leaves to be arrested.
add.whoB: Liam's ex, who abandons him to the police.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#9
add.text: Tandy bails Liam out, but when she tries to steal his hope Tyrone stops her. Liam then steals the money Scarborough paid her.
add.whoA: Tandy's ex, who steals her money.
add.whoB: Liam's ex, who tries to steal his hope.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#1
add.text: Adina is Tyrone's mother, who is overprotective of him and tells him she does not want to lose him the way she lost Billy.
add.whoA: Tyrone's mother, who fears losing him.
add.whoB: Adina's son, whom she fears losing.

add.title: Cloak & Dagger#2
add.text: When Tyrone touches Adina he sees her greatest fear, that she will lose him the way she lost Billy.
add.whoA: Tyrone's mother, who fears losing him.
add.whoB: Adina's son, whom she fears losing.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
add.text: Dale and Stacey adopted Molly after her parents died. She lives with them and her sister Gert.
add.whoA: Molly's adoptive parents.
add.whoB: Dale and Stacey's adopted daughter.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
add.text: Tina and Robert are married, Nico's parents and members of PRIDE.
add.whoA: Tina's husband, a member of PRIDE.
add.whoB: Robert's wife, a member of PRIDE.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#1
add.text: Tina is Nico's mother and a member of PRIDE.
add.whoA: Nico's mother, a member of PRIDE.
add.whoB: Tina's daughter.

add.title: Runaways S1–S2#11
add.text: Darius is Livvie's brother in law, the partner of her sister Tamar. Livvie meets Alex while he is working for Darius.
add.whoA: Livvie's brother in law.
add.whoB: Darius's sister in law.
